title: Mean yield
context: Start with the average outcome of the agronomy trial.
task: Set result to the mean of the plots yield column, rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Median rainfall
context: The robust centre of the rainfall readings.
task: Set result to the median of the plots rainfall column, rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Yield standard deviation
task: Set result to the sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of yield, rounded to 2 decimals.
hint: .std() uses ddof=1 by default in pandas.

title: Yield variance
task: Set result to the sample variance (ddof=1) of yield, rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Yield range
task: Set result to the range (max - min) of yield, rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Interquartile range
task: Set result to the IQR (Q3 - Q1) of yield, rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Plots per fertilizer
task: Set result to a Series of the number of plots per fertilizer, sorted by fertilizer name.

title: Mean yield per fertilizer
task: Set result to a Series of mean yield per fertilizer, rounded to 2 decimals, sorted by fertilizer.

title: Best fertilizer
context: Which fertilizer has the highest mean yield?
task: Set result to the fertilizer (a string) with the highest mean yield.

title: 90th percentile yield
task: Set result to the 90th percentile of yield, rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Coefficient of variation
task: Set result to the coefficient of variation of yield (std ddof=1 / mean * 100), rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Mean absolute deviation
task: Set result to the mean absolute deviation of yield about its mean, rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Number of plots
task: Set result to the number of plots (rows), as an integer.

title: Mean pre score
task: Set result to the mean pre score in training, rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Mean post score
task: Set result to the mean post score in training, rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Mean improvement
context: How much did trainees gain on average?
task: Set result to the mean of (post - pre) across trainees, rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Trainees who improved
task: Set result to the number of trainees whose post score is strictly greater than their pre score, as an integer.

title: Proportion improved
task: Set result to the proportion of trainees whose post > pre, rounded to 3 decimals.

title: Pearson correlation
context: Linear association between x and y.
task: Set result to the Pearson correlation coefficient between bivar x and y, rounded to 3 decimals.

title: Spearman correlation
context: Rank (monotonic) association, robust to the outlier.
task: Set result to the Spearman correlation between bivar x and y, rounded to 3 decimals.

title: Total visitors
task: Set result to the total number of visitors across the ab experiment, as an integer.

title: Overall conversion rate
task: Set result to the overall conversion rate (total conversions / total visitors) as a percentage, rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Conversion rate per variant
context: Rate for A and B separately.
task: Set result to a Series (indexed by variant, sorted) of conversion rate = conversions/visitors, rounded to 4 decimals.
hint: set_index('variant') then divide the two columns.

title: Votes per candidate
task: Set result to a Series of vote counts per candidate, sorted by candidate.

title: Most popular candidate
task: Set result to the most frequently chosen candidate (a string).

title: Number of regions
task: Set result to the number of distinct regions in poll, as an integer.

title: Skewness of yield
task: Set result to the skewness of yield (scipy default), rounded to 4 decimals.

title: Excess kurtosis of yield
task: Set result to the excess kurtosis of yield (scipy default, Fisher), rounded to 4 decimals.

title: Z-score of the max yield
context: How many SDs above the mean is the best plot?
task: Set result to (max yield - mean yield) / std (ddof=1), rounded to 3 decimals.
answer:
y = plots['yield']
result = round(float((y.max() - y.mean()) / y.std(ddof=1)), 3)

title: 10% trimmed mean
task: Set result to the 10% trimmed mean of yield, rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Geometric mean yield
task: Set result to the geometric mean of yield, rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Standard error of the mean
context: Precision of the mean yield estimate.
task: Set result to the standard error of the mean of yield, rounded to 3 decimals.

title: Yield std per fertilizer
task: Set result to a Series of yield std (ddof=1) per fertilizer, rounded to 2 decimals, sorted by fertilizer.

title: Mean rainfall per region
context: Did the regions differ in rainfall?
task: Set result to a Series of mean rainfall per region, rounded to 2 decimals, sorted by region.
